Definition: an appellation, as a mark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
BiblicalUsage: A name is what a thing is called, and in Scripture a name carries the thing itself. Unto Eber were born two sons, and the name of the one was Peleg, because in his days the earth was divided; Jair called the country after his own name; and God promises, I will make you a name and a praise among all people of the earth. Isaiah hears that a man from the north shall call upon God's name.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a name is never just a label in the Bible. God gives names, men take names, and God promises to make His people a name and a praise, and I hold that the name that matters most is His.
